name: github.com/tidwall/gjson
reason: Path query API gjson.GetBytes/Parse over bytes; documented as not validating JSON (gjson.Valid is a separate call), so not taken as the next general-purpose decoder. Not run.

name: github.com/ugorji/go/codec
reason: Multi-format codec (msgpack, cbor, binc, simple, json); its Imported by count covers every format, so it is not comparable with JSON-only packages. JSON decoder path not run.

name: github.com/mailru/easyjson/jlexer
reason: Lexer for generated easyjson code; a generic local-bytes decode into an untyped value remains unchecked.

name: github.com/bytedance/sonic
reason: Documentation describes JIT/SIMD paths and an encoding/json-compatible fallback on unsupported platforms; linux/arm64 parser family remains unchecked.

name: github.com/buger/jsonparser
reason: Byte-slice Get/ArrayEach/ObjectEach parser; control not run in this pilot.

name: k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/util/json
reason: Wrapper over sigs.k8s.io/json, an encoding/json fork; would share the Go encoding/json lineage. Not run.

name: github.com/valyala/fastjson
reason: Parser.ParseBytes over bytes; control not run in this pilot.
